scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun build ./index.html --outdir=dist --minify && cp -R src/app/styles/fonts dist/fonts && cp src/fixtures/snapshot.json dist/snapshot.json

simple-git-hooks.pre-commit: bun run biome check --staged --no-errors-on-unmatched && if command -v gitleaks >/dev/null 2>&1; then gitleaks git --staged -v --redact --no-banner; fi
simple-git-hooks.pre-push: bun run lint && bun run lint:yaml && bun run lint:suppressions && bun run typecheck && bun test --pass-with-no-tests && if command -v actionlint >/dev/null 2>&1; then actionlint -color; fi && if command -v gitleaks >/dev/null 2>&1; then gitleaks git . --log-opts="$(git symbolic-ref --quiet --short refs/remotes/origin/HEAD || echo main)..HEAD" -v --redact --no-banner; fi && rm -rf reports/mutation && bunx --no-install stryker run && bun scripts/mutation-floor.ts && { bash scripts/diff-budget.sh || true; }

rootFiles.CLAUDE.md: always-on agent rules, read at the start of every session
rootFiles.README.md: the front door, where a reader arrives before any directory
rootFiles.index.html: the bundler entry point `bun build ./index.html` expects here
rootFiles.package.json: the manifest bun resolves from the root and nowhere else
rootFiles.bun.lock: the lockfile bun writes beside the manifest
rootFiles.bunfig.toml: bun's own configuration, read from the root
rootFiles.tsconfig.json: the compiler reads it from the root of the project
rootFiles.biome.json: biome resolves its configuration from the root
rootFiles.stryker.config.json: stryker resolves its configuration from the root
rootFiles.playwright.config.ts: playwright resolves its configuration from the root
rootFiles..coderabbit.yaml: the review bot reads it from the repository root
rootFiles..gitignore: git reads it from the root, and it governs the whole tree
rootFiles..env.example: copied to `.env`, which tooling reads from the root
rootFiles.Dockerfile: the build context's root is the directory holding it
rootFiles..dockerignore: read from the build context's root, beside the Dockerfile
rootFiles.docker-compose.yml: the deployment's project file, resolved from the root
